notes:
Summary: Stalled → ultimately closed-lost on networking requirement. Primary ask was vendor-managed PrivateLink endpoint + VPC endpoint support for cross-account traffic. Redwood Private roadmap included VPC peering + on-prem later in Q3 but no PrivateLink ETA acceptable to customer.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2024-08-15: Lead created via conference intro (Ava M). initial discovery call noted 60% of LLM workload will touch PII metadata.
- 2024-09-03: Technical deep dive with infra team (SE: Liam Chen). customer insists on PrivateLink or direct connect for egress policy.
- 2024-11-07: Product demo (FF-2024-11-07-astral-demo). demo well received; latency & cost numbers looked good for batch reranking.
- 2024-12-10: Security questionnaire submitted (drive link). network team asks for PrivateLink or Transit Gateway support + firewall IP ranges.
- 2025-01-21: Security deep-dive call (FF-2025-01-21-security-deep-dive). Product PM attended; roadmap conversation — PM stated PrivateLink is "not prioritized" until Q4 and would require additional eng effort.
- 2025-01-28: Pricing & contract redlines sent; customer said they need PrivateLink or they'll consider other vendors.
- 2025-02-06: Competitor demo (AetherCloud) — they committed to PrivateLink + 2-week onboarding. customer pulled procurement.
- 2025-02-10: Deal marked as closed-lost to AetherCloud. AE notes: "Network team would not accept VPC peering workaround; compliance required endpoint in their account."

Key quotes / signals:
- Head of Cloud: "We cannot open our VPC to third-party peering. PrivateLink is non-negotiable for 3rd-party APIs."
- Security lead: "Need KMS integration and proof of audit logging retention before pilot."

Why we lost / stalled details:
- Product mismatch: Redwood Private roadmap did not include PrivateLink support within the customer's timeline; VPC peering/on-prem timeline too slow.
- Internal champion attrition: original sponsor (Dir. of ML Ops) left in Nov, no strong replacement to push internal priority.
- Competitor advantage: AetherCloud offered PrivateLink + supported SAML/KMS quicker and provided a pilot license.
- Budget: not primary — they were prepared to sign if networking controls satisfied.

Actions taken by AE/SE:
- Escalated to product on 2025-01-22; PM provided technical constraints and rough ETA (Q4).
- Offered interim mitigations: managed transit gateway design, IP allowlist, and limited on-prem deployment for pilot — all rejected by network/security.
- Legal requested flow logs SLA addendum; security said insufficient without PrivateLink.

Open follow-ups and playbook notes (for re-engagement):
- If Redwood implements PrivateLink or endpoint-in-customer-account pattern, re-engage (high likelihood to reopen procurement).
- Maintain quarterly check-ins; watch for reorganizations (new Dir. of ML Ops).
- Keep pricing file and security questionnaire updated; attach sample PrivateLink architecture when available.

Stated customer next steps: "Pausing procurement while we pilot AetherCloud for PrivateLink. If their pilot shows gaps, we'll reach back out."

Internal meta: Mark as reference for "networking blockers" closed-lost reasons. Good example of mismatch between product roadmap and enterprise networking constraints.
